ability.name: Zealous Orator
ability.effect: If a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

ability.name: Bathed in Blood
ability.effect: **Heal (3)** this unit if it is in combat.

ability.name: Master of Poisons
ability.effect:
For the rest of the battle:
• The target cannot be healed.
• Slain models cannot be returned to the target unit.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s combat attacks to be the target.
